meaning_en: Feeling fear; scared of something.
example_en: She is afraid of spiders.
examples_extra: The little boy is afraid of the dark.
Are you afraid to swim in deep water?
note_fa: بعد از آن of یا to می‌آید: afraid of dogs / afraid to ask.

meaning_en: Feeling fear about something.
example_en: Are you afraid of the dark?
examples_extra: She is afraid of spiders and mice.
He's afraid of flying, so he takes the train.
note_fa: همیشه با of می‌آید و بعد از آن اسم یا ing.

meaning_en: to share the same idea or belief
example_en: We both agree on the plan.
examples_extra: I agree with you on this point.
Experts agree that exercise is good for health.
note_fa: ساختار: agree with + شخص یا نظر.

meaning_en: To say sorry about a reason or action.
example_en: He apologised for being late.
examples_extra: She apologised for the noise during the party last night.
I want to apologise for what I said yesterday.
note_fa: بعد از for اسم یا ing می‌آید: apologise for being late.

meaning_en: To request something.
example_en: I will ask for a glass of water.
examples_extra: The child asked for a glass of water.
She asked for permission to leave the class early.
note_fa: بعد از for همیشه اسم می‌آید، نه فعل.

meaning_en: The final part or conclusion of something.
example_en: We will meet at the end of the street.
examples_extra: He waved goodbye at the end of the film.
Write your name at the end of the letter.
note_fa: با in the end (در نهایت) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: Now; right now.
example_en: I am busy at the moment.
examples_extra: I'm busy at the moment; can I call you back?
She is on holiday at the moment with family.

meaning_en: Knowing about something.
example_en: Are you aware of the problem?
examples_extra: Are you fully aware of the new rules?
She was aware of the danger but stayed calm.
note_fa: همیشه با of می‌آید: aware of.

meaning_en: Not good at doing something.
example_en: I am bad at remembering names.
examples_extra: I am bad at remembering names, so I write them down.
He was always bad at maths but excellent at drawing.
note_fa: بعد از آن اسم یا فعل-ing می‌آید: bad at swimming.

meaning_en: Be familiar with something, so it feels normal.
example_en: I am used to waking up early.
examples_extra: It takes time to be used to getting up early.
She will never be used to the cold weather here.
note_fa: «عادت داشتن به» — بعد از آن فعل-ing یا اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: To be owned by someone.
example_en: This book belongs to me.
examples_extra: This old bike belongs to my younger brother.
The painting belongs to a famous museum in Paris.
note_fa: به معنی مالکیت؛ هرگز passive نمی‌شود.

meaning_en: Without intending to; unintentionally.
example_en: I broke the vase by accident.
examples_extra: I met an old friend by accident at the station.
He broke the expensive glass by accident yesterday.
note_fa: مترادف accidentally؛ متضاد on purpose.

meaning_en: Without planning; accidentally.
example_en: I met my old friend by chance.
examples_extra: We met by chance at the busy airport.
I found this rare book by chance in a small shop.
note_fa: یعنی تصادفی؛ شبیه by accident.

meaning_en: Using your hands, not a machine.
example_en: She wrote the letter by hand.
examples_extra: She made this beautiful carpet entirely by hand.
The long letter was written by hand, not typed.
note_fa: یعنی با دست، نه با ماشین.

meaning_en: Accidentally; because of an error.
example_en: I took the wrong bag by mistake.
examples_extra: I took your black bag by mistake this morning.
She sent the email to the wrong person by mistake.
note_fa: یعنی اشتباهی؛ شبیه by accident.

meaning_en: To reach a total amount.
example_en: The bill came to fifty dollars.
examples_extra: The bill comes to twenty pounds.
All the costs will come to more than we expected.
note_fa: برای جمع شدن مبلغ: The bill came to £20.

meaning_en: To give all your attention to one thing.
example_en: Please concentrate on your homework.
examples_extra: I cannot concentrate with all this noise.
She concentrated on her studies and passed the exam.
note_fa: concentrate on + اسم: تمرکز روی چیزی.

meaning_en: To be controlled or decided by something else.
example_en: Our picnic depends on the weather.
examples_extra: It depends on the weather whether we go out.
Our plans depend on getting the visa in time.
note_fa: کتاب: همیشه با on می‌آید؛ it depends on... (نه it depends of).

word: depend on sb [need sb to support you]
meaning_en: To need someone for support or help.
meaning_fa: متکی بودن به، وابسته بودن به
example_en: Children depend on their parents for everything.
examples_extra: Young children depend on their parents completely.
She depends on her friends for emotional support.
note_fa: یعنی «به کسی تکیه کردن»؛ dependent on یعنی وابسته به.

meaning_en: Not the same as something else.
example_en: My new phone is very different from my old one.
examples_extra: Her taste in music is different from mine.
The climate here is very different from my home country.
note_fa: عبارت کامل: different from + اسم/ضمیر.

meaning_en: Become familiar with something new.
example_en: It takes time to get used to a new city.
examples_extra: You'll soon get used to the cold weather.
It took me a month to get used to the new job.
note_fa: بعدش اسم یا فعل + ing می‌آید: get used to driving.

meaning_en: Able to do something well.
example_en: She is very good at playing the piano.
examples_extra: She is good at maths.
He is good at fixing cars.
note_fa: «در چیزی خوب بودن»؛ good at + ing.

meaning_en: able or unable to do something well.
example_en: I am good at cooking pasta.
examples_extra: She is good at maths.
He is good at drawing.
note_fa: «در چیزی خوب/بد بودن»؛ be good at sth.

meaning_en: Pleased with something.
example_en: She is happy about her new job.
examples_extra: I am really happy about my exam results.
She was happy about the news of her promotion.
note_fa: خوشحال از (خبر/اتفاق)؛ نه happy for در این معنی.

meaning_en: Moving or doing something quickly.
example_en: I'm in a hurry, so I can't talk now.
examples_extra: I'm in a hurry, I can't talk now.
They left in a hurry this morning.

meaning_en: Very soon, in a short time.
example_en: I'll be ready to leave in a moment.
examples_extra: I'll be with you in a moment.
Dinner will be ready in a moment.
note_fa: یعنی «یک لحظه دیگر/خیلی زود».

meaning_en: Operating a company or trade.
example_en: Our family has been in business for fifty years.
examples_extra: They have been in business for ten years.
It's hard to stay in business today.

meaning_en: Including all the facts and information.
example_en: Please explain your plan in detail.
examples_extra: She explained everything in detail.
Tell me about the trip in detail.

meaning_en: From now on, at a later time.
example_en: In future, please arrive on time.
examples_extra: In future, please send the report by email.
They plan to travel more in future.
note_fa: از این پس؛ in the future هم همین معناست.

meaning_en: Crying, with tears in your eyes.
example_en: She was in tears after hearing the sad news.
examples_extra: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
He left the room in tears after the argument.
note_fa: گریان؛ burst into tears یعنی زدن زیر گریه.

meaning_en: Finally, after a long time or many changes.
example_en: We tried many ways, and in the end, we succeeded.
examples_extra: In the end, they decided to stay at home.
We tried three hotels and, in the end, chose the cheapest.
note_fa: سرانجام؛ با at the end قاطی نشود.

meaning_en: Early enough; before it is too late.
example_en: We arrived at the station just in time for our train.
examples_extra: She arrived in time to catch the bus.
Hurry up, or we won't be there in time.
note_fa: به‌موقع؛ با on time (سر ساعت) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: Wanting to know or learn about something.
example_en: I am interested in learning new languages.
examples_extra: She is deeply interested in ancient history.
Are you interested in joining our club?
note_fa: علاقه‌مند به؛ بعدش اسم یا ing.

meaning_en: To hear and pay attention to.
example_en: She likes to listen to the radio.
examples_extra: Do you listen to the radio every morning?
She listens to podcasts on her way to work.
note_fa: «گوش دادن به»؛ to همیشه همراهش است.

meaning_en: take care of someone or something.
example_en: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
examples_extra: She looks after her elderly mother.
Who will look after the dog?
note_fa: مراقبت کردن از؛ look after somebody/something.

meaning_en: direct your eyes towards something.
example_en: Please look at the picture on the wall.
examples_extra: Look at this photo from our trip.
The doctor looked at my throat.
note_fa: نگاه کردن به؛ look at the suggestions (کتاب).

meaning_en: try to find something or someone.
example_en: I need to look for my keys.
examples_extra: I am looking for my keys.
She is looking for a new job.
note_fa: دنبال چیزی گشتن؛ look for (نه look to).

meaning_en: feel happy and excited about something in the future.
example_en: I look forward to seeing you next week.
examples_extra: I look forward to meeting you.
We look forward to hearing from you.
note_fa: بعدش اسم یا ing می‌آید (نه مصدر): look forward to seeing you.

meaning_en: very much in love with someone.
meaning_fa: دیوانه کسی بودن، عاشق کسی بودن
example_en: He is completely mad about his new girlfriend.
examples_extra: He is mad about his new girlfriend.
She is mad about football.
note_fa: دیوانه‌وار عاشق کسی/چیزی بودن؛ غیررسمی.

meaning_en: On a ship, train, or aircraft.
example_en: All passengers are now on board the plane.
examples_extra: All passengers are now on board.
Welcome on board our flight to Paris.
note_fa: یعنی سوار هواپیما/کشتی/قطار بودن.

meaning_en: Traveling for work, not for pleasure.
example_en: He went to London on business.
examples_extra: He is in Berlin on business.
She travels on business twice a month.
note_fa: یعنی برای کار (نه تفریح) سفر کردن.

meaning_en: Shown for people to see.
example_en: The new paintings are on display at the gallery.
examples_extra: The paintings are on display this week.
New cars were on display at the show.
note_fa: یعنی به نمایش گذاشته شده.

meaning_en: Burning; covered in flames.
example_en: The old building was on fire.
examples_extra: The old house was on fire.
Part of the building caught on fire.
note_fa: catch fire هم یعنی آتش گرفتن.

meaning_en: Intentionally; not by accident.
example_en: He broke the glass on purpose.
examples_extra: He broke it on purpose, I think.
She did not do it on purpose.
note_fa: یعنی عمداً؛ متضادش by accident است.

meaning_en: Refusing to work as a protest.
example_en: The factory workers are on strike.
examples_extra: The teachers are on strike today.
Bus drivers went on strike last week.
note_fa: go on strike یعنی اعتصاب کردن.

meaning_en: Talking using a telephone.
example_en: She is on the phone with her friend.
examples_extra: She is on the phone right now.
He talked on the phone for an hour.
note_fa: یعنی در حال صحبت با تلفن؛ با on می‌آید.

meaning_en: Punctually; at the correct time.
example_en: The train arrived on time.
examples_extra: The train arrived on time.
Please be on time for the meeting.
note_fa: با in time (زودتر از موعد) اشتباه نگیرید.

meaning_en: Old-fashioned; no longer useful or current.
example_en: This information is completely out-of-date.
examples_extra: This map is badly out-of-date now.
His ideas seem rather out-of-date.
note_fa: منسوخ؛ متضاد آن up-to-date است.

meaning_en: To give money in exchange for something.
example_en: I need to pay for my coffee.
examples_extra: Who will pay for dinner?
They will pay for the tickets online.

meaning_en: Feeling happy about something good someone did.
example_en: I am proud of my sister for winning the race.
examples_extra: She is proud of her children.
We are proud of our team.
note_fa: به ... افتخار می‌کند.

meaning_en: To need or depend on someone or something.
example_en: You can always rely on him for help.
examples_extra: You can rely on him; he never breaks a promise.
We rely on the bus to get to work.
note_fa: متکی بودن؛ rely on یعنی «اعتماد به».

meaning_en: Pleased with something or someone.
example_en: I am satisfied with my exam results.
examples_extra: She is satisfied with the result.
Are you satisfied with your room?
note_fa: راضی بودن از؛ satisfied with + اسم.

meaning_en: Not having enough of something.
example_en: We are short of milk, so I'll buy some.
examples_extra: We are really short of time this morning.
The busy shop is badly short of staff.
note_fa: کم داشتن؛ be short of.

meaning_en: To speak loudly to someone.
meaning_fa: سر کسی فریاد زدن/به کسی داد زدن
example_en: He shouted at the children to stop.
examples_extra: Please don't shout at the little children again.
She shouted loudly to him across the street.
note_fa: سر کسی فریاد زدن؛ shout at یا to.

meaning_en: Almost the same, but not exactly.
example_en: Our ideas are very similar.
examples_extra: Our musical tastes are quite similar, I think.
The two old houses look quite similar outside.
note_fa: مشابه؛ similar to.

meaning_en: There is a problem with it.
example_en: There's something wrong with my computer.
examples_extra: There's something wrong with the TV.
Is there something wrong with your car?

meaning_en: Use money to buy something.
example_en: I spend too much money on clothes.
examples_extra: They spend a lot of money on clothes.
How much do you spend on food weekly?
note_fa: پول خرج کردن برای؛ spend on.

meaning_en: To express gratitude for something.
example_en: I want to thank you for your help.
examples_extra: Thank you for coming today.
I thank you for your help.
note_fa: «تشکر کردن برای».

meaning_en: to consider something; to ponder.
example_en: I need to think about your offer.
examples_extra: Think about the offer before you decide.
I often think about my childhood in the village.
note_fa: درباره چیزی فکر کردن؛ در نظر گرفتن.

meaning_en: to imagine or consider doing something.
example_en: I'm thinking of going to the beach.
examples_extra: Think of joining us for the trip this summer.
I can’t think of a better place to live.
note_fa: به فکر انجام کاری بودن؛ تصور کردن.

meaning_en: to send something through the air to someone.
meaning_fa: چیزی را به سمت کسی پرتاب کردن
example_en: He threw the ball to his friend.
examples_extra: Throw the ball to me when you are ready.
He will throw the ball back to you.
note_fa: چیزی را به سمت کسی پرتاب کردن.

meaning_en: bored with something; no longer interested.
example_en: I'm tired of eating pasta every day.
examples_extra: I am tired of eating the same food.
She is tired of his constant complaining every day.
note_fa: «خسته و دلزده از»؛ tired of doing.

meaning_en: To change words from one language to another.
example_en: Can you translate this sentence into English?
examples_extra: Could you please translate this letter into English?
She translates famous novels from French to English.
note_fa: «ترجمه کردن»؛ translate into.

meaning_en: Modern and current; having the newest information.
example_en: Make sure your software is up-to-date.
examples_extra: Is this map really up-to-date?
Try to keep your skills up-to-date.
note_fa: یعنی به‌روز؛ متضاد out-of-date.

meaning_en: something that happened regularly in the past but not now
example_en: I used to play football every day.
examples_extra: I used to play football.
She used to live here.
note_fa: برای عادت گذشته؛ بعدش فعل ساده می‌آید.

meaning_en: To stay until someone or something arrives.
example_en: I will wait for you at the bus stop.
examples_extra: I am still waiting for the late bus.
She patiently waited for him at the station.
note_fa: منتظر ماندن؛ wait for + اسم.

meaning_en: To feel anxious or unhappy about something.
example_en: Don't worry about the exam, you'll do great.
examples_extra: Don't worry about the exam.
She worries about her health.
